title: Supreme Court hearing on Delhi riots
content:
Intellectuals turning terrorists more dangerous, Supreme Court told in riots case
Delhi police said a trend has emerged where intellectuals were using state funding to become doctors and engineers and then engage in anti-national activities. The Supreme Court was hearing the bail pleas of activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam.
author: Ashish Law & Associates
